Pelpelajax Falsely banned Pinghacks which was at a sleepover at my house. He falsely judged his ip history which was my ip. I should be unbanned because I think I had a good reason in my previous apeal. And I was not Ban evading. Pinghacks was unbanned and is my friend, not me.
